text:
Jon (sales): heads-up — NovaClinic (prospect) sent a security packet. they require HIPAA + 7yr retention for PHI audit logs and streaming audit exports to their AWS account. they also asked for per-tenant soft-delete and signed log immutability. forwarding packet: <link to doc>
Anika (product): thanks — do we have the questionnaire? can someone paste the specific audit export format they asked for?
Jon (sales): pasted key bits: they want a kafka/kinesis-compatible stream + a signed checksum per-batch and a retention TTL configurable per-tenant. also want an admin UI to set retention and initiate legal deletes. they expect POC before contract.
Priya (eng-platform): rough technical note: streaming export + per-tenant TTL is doable server-side. immutability (append-only, signed) needs either an S3-write-with-versioning + KMS-signed manifests or a ledger service — not trivial.
Liam (security): flagged: SOC2 control: logs must be tamper-evident and key custody needs to be customer-controlled for their compliance. they asked for KMS/HSM integration + exported audit manifest signed with customer key.
Matea (solutions): timeline ask from NovaClinic: they want to pilot in 6w. they're pushing this as procurement condition.
Anika (product): proposal: split into 2-phase scope
• Phase 1 (MVP, 3w): streaming export to customer-owned S3/Kinesis, docs + schema, server-side per-tenant TTL enforcement, delivered as backend-only POC (no UI)
• Phase 2 (UI + signed immutability, 4–6w): admin console for retention settings, per-tenant deletion workflow with audit, optional signed manifests using customer KMS
Can we agree on minimal acceptance criteria for phase 1?
Priya (eng-platform): acceptance criteria for phase 1 (suggested):
- export pipeline to customer endpoint (S3/Kinesis) tested end-to-end
- retention TTL enforced per-tenant (config via env/infra flag)
- schema v1 documented and sample consumer config provided
- basic tests for retention + delivery guarantees
- infra runbook for onboarding (IAM role steps)
Liam (security): add: encryption-in-transit requirement, log schema omits PHI in cleartext, and a compliance checklist doc for legal (SOC2 artifact)
Jon (sales): customer will need signed statement for POC demonstrating export replayability and retention enforcement — can add that to deliverables.
SupportBot: created ticket RF-4321: "novaclinic - audit export & retention POC" and linked to internal ops board. assignee: unassigned. priority: high.
Anika (product): rough dev estimate from eng: full Phase1 backend ~3w (1 eng + infra support), Phase2 UI + KMS integration ~4–6w (frontend + security + infra). we should surface as a customer-driven feature on roadmap and request budget.
Matea (solutions): careful — customer procurement needs timeline commitment. If we commit to phase1 in 3 weeks, we must ensure onboarding slot and a runbook. i'll own onboarding checklist.
Priya (eng-platform): note on complexity: if we implement signed manifests with customer KMS, we'll need a short design doc + threat model. that's Phase2 work.
Anika (product): proposed launch criteria (Phase1 POC):
- end-to-end export verified by customer
- retention policy applied and demonstrable via test harness
- documentation & onboarding steps published
- security review (Liam sign-off)
If all green, mark POC complete and open Phase2 scoping.
Jon (sales): can we get a fast estimate for scope to put into the SOW? even a T-shirt size is fine.
Priya (eng-platform): T-shirt estimate: Phase1 = S (2 dev-weeks + infra 1w), Phase2 = M-L (4–6 dev-weeks + security work). caveat: KMS/HSM integration adds ops overhead.
Liam (security): will prepare SOC2 artifact template and required controls list. ETA 5 business days.
Anika (product): action items:
- create backlog epic INF-AUDIT-2026 (product)
- attach RF-4321 to epic (support)
- eng-platform to draft design doc for export pipeline (pri)
- security to draft compliance checklist (liam)
- solutions to prep onboarding runbook (matea)
Sarah (product-ops): i'll add INF-AUDIT-2026 to roadmap board and block a pilot slot on calendar. ping me when RF-4321 is updated.
Jon (sales): thanks — i'll push back on exact KMS wording in packet for POC to keep scope small. :thumbsup:
Anika (product): ok let's aim to have Phase1 plan + RFC by end of week. moving to a doc: https://redwood-internal/docs/roadmap/audit-export-poc
Priya (eng-platform): :eyes: noting dependencies: IAM roles, S3 lifecycle policy template, consumer validation test harness.
Matea (solutions): i'll draft the customer acceptance script and runbook today and link to RF-4321.
Liam (security): +1, will run an initial security quick-check once design doc posted.
SupportBot: RF-4321 updated: epic INF-AUDIT-2026 created.
Anika (product): good thread — i'll follow up with RFC and schedule quick sync with eng + security tomorrow.
Sarah (product-ops): copied checklist into roadmap card and assigned initial owners. :white_check_mark:
